title: Person: Nasty Roche

Nasty Roche

anchor.prefix:
ptain of the third line all the fellows said.

 Rody Kickham was a decent fellow but Nasty Roche was a stink. Rody Kickham had greaves in his number and a hamper in the refectory.
anchor.suffix:
had big hands. He called the Friday pudding dog-in-the-blanket. And one day he had asked:

 —What is your name?

 Stephen had answered: Stephen Dedalus.
